verdicts.notes: great shelves and placement, and i like the texture, but the face needs a lot of work. and the underlying monstrous mouth doesn’t seem to exist. and i’d love a more robustly writhing, eye-covered, mouth-covered feature in with this beksinski texturing. overall quite great start.

id prefer the support leg on the bottom shelf to be more integrated into the design as a whole, right now it sticks out unrelated to the prior sculpture. further, the textures are locally correct and locally the aesthetic I would like, but the overall creature form has not been preserved. It lacks the cohesive organic texture that I was hoping for and simply kind of went all in on the Besinsky horrific writhing texture, which is a good direction, but we need to resume our intention on the organic tones

The design and aesthetic choice of this is really really lacking. We need to make serious progress on updating this face design. I would like to return towards the design of the classic smiley emoticon and start with that rather than have this blank nondescript face. I would like you to do some serious reviewing on this one.
absolutely love the depth and design of this. I think everything on how the side profile pans out is correct, barring whatever edits we make to the other aspects of this
this smiley mask looks comical, childish, and highly imperfect. I do not like this at all. I would like serious revision on this front.
